sentences.text: Datonglong was a herbivorous ornithopod dinosaur belonging to the Hadrosauroidea superfamily that lived in present-day China during the Late Cretaceous. It was established as a new genus due to its unique dental structures.
The teeth are large, with intact teeth reaching up to 5.5 cm in height. They are arranged in groups of three or four within the tooth battery.

Datonglong was one of eighteen dinosaur taxa described in 2015 in open access or free-to-read journals.

A team from the Shanxi Museum of Geological and Mineral Science and Technology discovered a euornithopod jaw in the Kangdailiang quarry in Shanxi in 2008. The fossil was found within a layer of the Huiquanpu Formation.

The species Datonglong tianzhenensis was named and described in 2016 by Xu Shicha, You Hailu, Wang Jiawei, Wang Suozhu, Yi Jian, and Jia Lei. The genus name Datonglong refers to the city of Datong and the Chinese word for dragon. The specific name tianzhenensis refers to the fossil's origin in Tianzhen county.

The fossil is believed to date from the Cenomanian-Campanian timeframe, roughly between 95 and 80 million years ago. Although the exact deposition time is unknown, the fossil is believed to be from the Cenomaniense to Campaniense epochs, approximately 95 to 80 million years ago.
